race.comment: ABERDEEN FLYER (7) closed nicely in the Northam Cup but he couldn't reel in MEMORY PARADE. Only second-up there however and should have plenty of improvement to come now as he steps up to 1800m. Getting away from the fence should help also and he can turn the tables. MEMORY PARADE (10) took off and skipped away in the Northam Cup and couldn't be caught, winning by 1.7L. Drawn inside now, but she should sit every chance for Faithfull and the rise to 1800m isn't an issue. Can keep the ball rolling. ALL GRUNT (8) was just okay in the Kalgoorlie Cup before landing the knockout blow over 2200m here last start in a strong effort. Back to 1800m is the query, but there's still a feeling he hasn't hit his ceiling yet. He looks right in this with things suiting. OLY'S CHOICE (6) comes through the Northam Cup and that looks a strong form reference to follow. FOREVER BOY (2) can improve quickly third-up and out in distance.
